name: 飛ぶかたち (Tobu katachi), 1984
note: Stone and wood, shown at the 2nd Toyama International Contemporary Art Exhibition, Toyama Prefectural Museum of Modern Art, 1984. The page also shows 鳴るかたち (60×65×186 cm) and 梳くかたち (170×107×50 cm), both 1984, stone and wood. The maker is a best guess from the style and the 'かたち' titles, and I could not confirm it.
